item.title: Oklahoma Inc., Part 2 - Republican OK Governor Kevin Stitt Channels Democrat Obama With His New Education "Turnaround Team"
item.description: A critique of Governor Stitt's educational reforms in Oklahoma, arguing that they align with a centralized, data-driven system reminiscent of past failures like Common Core. It expresses concern over the replacement of key educational leaders by individuals perceived to prioritize governmental control over individual educational needs, ultimately disadvantaging parents and students.

item.title: The Tragedy Of State-Sponsored Child Kidnapping In Oklahoma Must Be Stopped
item.description: Roberta Lewis advocates for Dayna Mooney, an Oklahoma mother whose autistic son was forcibly placed on chemotherapy by DHS, despite her wishes. This situation highlights government overreach and mismanagement. Citizens are encouraged to engage in activism, attend the Liberty Oklahoma Conference, and support Dayna financially through a Give Send Go link.

item.title: Presten Mooney's Health Goes Down Hill Fast, While Government Turns The Screws
item.description: Presten Mooney, 17 yo autistic son of Dayna Mooney, was medically kidnapped from his doctor's office and given treatment neither he, nor his mother, wanted for him.

item.title: OK Republican Rep. Jim Shaw Discusses His 7 Point "Save Oklahoma Plan"
item.description: OK Rep. Jim Shaw discussed the "Save Oklahoma Plan," emphasizing the importance of E-Verify to combat illegal employment practices in Oklahoma. The plan includes stopping the green energy agenda, biosludge dumping, foreign land ownership, toll roads, vaccine status discrimination and taxpayer-funded lobbying. Also mandatory E-Verify use for all employees.

item.title: ROPE Report Withdraws From Save Oklahoma Plan
item.description: The author discusses their decision to withdraw support from the Save Oklahoma Plan due to concerns over the mandatory E-Verify requirement, while still expressing strong support for Representative Shaw and six other aspects of the plan. They advocate for unity and cooperation to focus on upcoming elections, emphasizing the importance of collaboration over conflict.

item.title: Are American Beef Prices Really High? Why Or Why Not?
item.description: Wednesday's podcast discussed beef prices with ranchers "JohnBoy" Stanley and Trent Loos, highlighting concerns over the U.S. beef industry’s consolidation and the impact of foreign-owned packers. It emphasized the need for Americans to source local meat and support independent farmers for better health and market diversity.

item.title: So You Think You Have A Non-REAL ID-Compliant Driver's License, Huh?
item.description: Oklahoma Senator Kendal Sacchieri urges citizens to contact Governor Stitt to halt the submission of Oklahoma's driver's license data to the national REAL ID database. She emphasizes the importance of personal data choice and warns against the potential privacy risks under REAL ID regulations, highlighting its implications for surveillance and digital identification.

item.title: Oklahoma's Data Center Invasion: A Community Struggles
item.description: Explore the controversial data center expansion in Oklahoma, raising concerns about water, electricity usage, and community impact. Get informed!
